references.text: Here we see an example of divorce in the Old Testament, where Abraham sends away Hagar.
This verse gives instructions about divorce, which provides background for Jesus' words in Matthew 19:9.
Jesus speaks about divorce and adultery, which is directly related to his teaching in Matthew 19:9.
The entire passage gives context to Jesus' teaching on divorce and adultery.
Luke gives a parallel teaching on divorce and adultery.
Mark gives another version of Jesus' teaching on divorce, which complements Matthew 19:9.
Paul refers to the Lord's words about marriage and divorce, which can be related to Jesus' teaching in Matthew 19:9.
